title: Breadboard launch
purpose: A product launch video for Breadboard as a workspace where a person, a team and their agents work in one place: home screen, gardens, chat with evidence, agents, the built-in browser, and the eight built-in places.
audience: People seeing Breadboard for the first time

creativeDirection.tone: Direct and busy: something changes on every beat
creativeDirection.look: Flat 2D, full frame, in the app's own light theme: pale green canvas, warm paper cards, ink text
creativeDirection.typography: Source Sans 3 throughout, as in the app; the title is the navbar lockup (logo and lowercase wordmark, medium weight) scaled up; IBM Plex Mono for commands
creativeDirection.pacing: One screen per eight-beat phrase, hard cuts on the downbeats, a 2D camera that moves to the active part of the screen every few beats

scenes.purpose: Five loose files land on the build hits, the drop pulls them into the lockup, a promise changes on every beat, then the lockup docks into the navbar of the home screen.
The home screen: widgets, search, the eight places lighting up across the drum roll, shortcuts, gardens, and the terminal rising from the dock.

shots.camera: Zooms to the active panel on the beat
text: One home for all your work.

scenes.purpose: Sources drop into a garden; a lesson is written with its formula, figure and page reference while the Learning Map grows.

shots.camera: Zooms to the active panel on the beat
text: Drop in what you know. Get it explained.

scenes.purpose: Chat in a shared garden: a question about a contract a teammate added, the streamed answer, the verdict, the source and the cited page.

shots.camera: Zooms to the active panel on the beat

scenes.purpose: The capability palette runs down its agents; Parametric CAD is chosen and models a wall bracket step by step while the part turns.

shots.camera: Zooms to the active panel on the beat

scenes.purpose: The built-in browser driven by an agent: it fills a supplier form on the four roll hits, submits, compares three offers and saves a sheet to the garden.

shots.camera: Zooms to the active panel on the beat
text: A browser your agents can drive.

scenes.purpose: Plan, Code, Organization, Timer, Settings, Voice, Gestures and Screen Time, one screen per beat.

shots.camera: Zooms to the active panel on the beat
text: Plan, code, talk, focus. All built in.

scenes.purpose: The lockup, a recap of what is inside, three verbs on the last roll, where to get it, then a small grey sign-off.

text: Free and open source, for Windows
